# Urban Gavelin

> Urban Gavelin is a Swedish B2B sales advisor, communication trainer and founder of Powersales Communication. He helps B2B companies sell smarter with clearer communication, stronger sales discipline and practical AI support.

Urban Gavelin works with CEOs, sales managers, founders and commercial teams in B2B companies with complex sales. His work focuses on commercial clarity, trust-building communication and practical AI integration in sales processes.

## Key pages

- [About Urban Gavelin](https://gavelin.net/en/urban-gavelin/): Background, focus areas and how Urban works
- [Expertise](https://gavelin.net/en/expertise/): B2B sales, communication and AI in sales
- [Advisory](https://gavelin.net/en/advisory/): Strategic advisory for commercial leaders
- [Training & Workshops](https://gavelin.net/en/training-workshops/): Practical programmes for sales teams
- [Powersales AI-Sales OS](https://gavelin.net/en/ai-sales-os/): AI-supported sales system for B2B
- [Insights](https://gavelin.net/en/insights/): Articles on B2B sales, AI and commercial leadership
- [AI Information](https://gavelin.net/en/ai-information/): Structured data for AI systems and search engines
- [Contact](https://gavelin.net/en/contact/): Book a 30-minute call
